DXC Technology is a global provider of information technology services that helps organizations modernize systems, manage workloads, integrate AI-powered intelligence, and strengthen security. The Analyst I Software Engineering role supports requirements gathering, system analysis, technical documentation, cross-functional communication, testing, and production issue troubleshooting.

Responsibilities
Requirement Gathering: Meet with business leaders and users to document clear project goals and technical specifications
System Analysis: Review existing software architectures to spot performance issues, security gaps, or areas for optimization
Technical Documentation: Create detailed functional designs, user stories, and Software Requirement Specification (SRS) documents
Cross-Functional Liaison: Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical teams and communicate business needs clearly to developers
Testing and Support: Participate in code reviews, coordinate defect tracking with quality assurance teams, and troubleshoot production issues
